bypasses.reason: RSC-mode-only CSRF bypass (action executes before the 400 response). DatIQ is a client-rendered Vite SPA using BrowserRouter — no React Server Components, no SSR, no server actions — so the vulnerable code path is unreachable. No patched version exists for React 18: every release falls under either this advisory (7.12.0-8.2.0) or the earlier open-redirect advisory GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 (<=7.17.0). The only clean release is react-router 8.3.0, which requires react >=19.2.7.
